evidence.source: Independent read-only verification of the Development project on 13 August 2026 confirms contract 189, applied through fast-lane rollout run 31751114401 from exact main e2edf6603c4a29ab0f7f50af369aaff67c6750b0. Confirmed by a query that NAMES the ledger row 20260813215920 ai_quarantined_evidence_reads rather than counting rows, beside a total of 189 and the named latest row. Custody was verified on the INSTALLED definitions, with line comments stripped first: ZERO admin AI reads reach ai.predictions or ai.bets, all four prediction reads name ai.valid_predictions, all three betting reads name ai.valid_bets, and the ai.valid_bets view exists with no grant to any browser role. Security is unchanged: 13 admin_ai_* functions are SECURITY DEFINER with an empty search_path and call require_competition_admin(), 13 executable by authenticated, 0 by anon. A HOSTED LIFECYCLE PROBE WAS RUN INSIDE A ROLLED-BACK TRANSACTION and proves the quarantine is dynamic rather than stamped at write time. Two forecasts were created with a graded result each, a settled bet with its own bet result each and an open bet each; all seven reads counted both. One forecast was then invalidated AFTER all of that existed, and on the very next call the dashboard's graded count, its calibration n, the performance breakdown's n, recent results, upcoming predictions, settled bets, CLV n, open bets, the per-market settled count and the publication gate's settled count each fell from 2 to 1; open exposure fell from 6.000 to 1.000; mean CLV became the valid bet's 0.12500 alone; and the invalidated forecast was absent BY ID from both upcoming predictions and recent results. Its underlying rows survived throughout — 1 prediction, 1 prediction result and 2 bets. The transaction was rolled back and Development still holds 0 predictions, 0 bets and 0 invalidations. PAID COLLECTION REMAINS DISABLED IN DEVELOPMENT and no paid provider request has ever been made there: ai.api_budget.collection_enabled is false and ai.api_usage holds 0 rows. This is database state only and claims no application publication.
